data.name: Giacobo
data.long_meaning: The name Giacobo, derived from the Hebrew 'Ya'aqob' meaning 'supplanter' or 'deceiver' because Jacob 'deceived' his father Isaac by taking the blessing meant for his older brother Esau. Later in life, Jacob was himself deceived by his sons Joseph's coat, but God's plan was ultimately fulfilled through Jacob.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of God's plan and deception leading to redemption and blessings.
data.numerology_meaning: Intuitive, creative, and magnetic. Excellent communicator and problem solver.

in_hebrew.name: יעקב
in_hebrew.meaning: מקור השם: יעקב, תרגום: ניצב, ראשוני, יקר, אב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מקור השם: יעקב (Gen 25:26), תרגום: ניצב, ראשוני, יקר, אב (Gen 25:26, Gen 27:36, Gen 32:28, Gen 35:10). שם האב הראשון במקרא. בראשית 25:26, 27:36, 32:28, 35:10. סמל לאב, לאחד, לקבוצה, ולאומת ישראל. השם נמצא 32 פעמים בספר תהילים.

in_greek.name: Ἰακώβ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰακώβ (Mt 1:2, Mk 9:35, Lk 3:34). ἐπώνυμος, πρωτότοκος, πολύτιμος, πατήρ (Gen 25:26, Gen 27:36, Gen 32:28, Gen 35:10). Ὀνόματα προέλευσης ἀπὸ Ἑβραϊκοῦ, ὀνομασία τοῦ πρωτοτόκου ἀπὸ τοῦ ἰακοβ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ. Ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰακωβ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ ἡ πίστις ὑπάρχει (Gen 15:6).

in_latin.name: Iacobus
in_latin.long_meaning: Iacobus (Mt 1:2, Mk 9:35, Lk 3:34). Pater, primogenitus, pretiosus (Gen 25:26, Gen 27:36, Gen 32:28, Gen 35:10). Nomen originis Hebraicae, nomen primogeniti a Iacobo, fratre Abrahae. Fides a Iacobo, fratre Abrahae, inest (Gen 15:6).
